content.short: Nabla Finance is a single-sided AMM yield protocol where depositors avoid paired exposure.
content.description: Nabla Finance lets liquidity providers deposit one asset rather than a pair, removing the requirement to hold something they did not want in order to earn fees. Single-sided provision shifts the divergence risk onto the protocol's pricing mechanism instead of the depositor, which is where the design work sits.
content.meta: Deposit one asset instead of a pair, moving divergence risk off the liquidity provider.
